description: Find foods in the Brazilian TACO table (597 items, per 100 g) by name in Portuguese. Accent-insensitive; tolerates typos; knows regional names (aipim, macaxeira, pão de sal, mandioquinha). Returns ids to use with get_nutrients. Restaurant dishes and brands are mostly absent.

query.description: Food name in Portuguese, e.g. "feijão carioca cozido" or "pao de queijo".

name: search_food

energy_kcal.description: Energy per 100 g of edible portion, in kcal.

id.description: TACO food number. Pass it to get_nutrients.

matched_via_synonym.description: Set when the food was found through this synonym of the query.

matched_via_typo.description: Set when nothing matched the query as typed: the corrected wording this food was found with. Check it is what the user meant.

name.description: Food name exactly as in the TACO table.

total_matches.description: How many foods in the table match the query.

title: Search foods in TACO
